name: Quick N Tasty (Garden City, UT) Seedless Hand-Spun Chocolate Malt Milkshake
brandOrRestaurant: Quick N Tasty (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Quick N Tasty's seedless lake alternative! Creamy vanilla soft-serve blended with chocolate syrup and malted barley powder. Completely seedless, eliminating the stricture danger of raspberry shakes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a small Chocolate Malt instead of the seeded raspberry shake.
watchOuts: Contains dairy lactose; take lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive
